purpose: Keep automatic cooling with a tested minimum active level for a Generic four-wire PWM fan.
revision_limits: CM5 Rev 1.0, BCM2712 D0, 4 GiB, CM5-NANO-B; carrier PCB revision not recorded. UEFI rpi5-20260730.1; exact firmware source pin not recorded. One Generic four-wire PWM fan was tested.
install_location: Merge into /etc/sysctl.conf on the selected EmberBSD device.
prerequisites: Check the actual ACPI thermal-zone name and cooling-device index mapping.
Confirm fan voltage, wiring and reliable start at the selected duty.
Use an EmberBSD kernel with the documented fan_min_level control.
activation_effect: Selects minimum active ACPI level 2 while retaining stronger automatic cooling steps; the recorded firmware maps this minimum to 125/255 PWM.
recovery_route: Restore the saved sysctl entries. The OS guide defines default automatic values: fan_min_level=-1, fan_max_only=0, force_fan=0. Recheck actual cooling after a policy change.
